title: Forecast: Apple guides its March-quarter gross margin below 45% on January 28
html:
Forecast

33.0%

Apple guides its March-quarter gross margin below 45% on January 28

Analyst estimate
Forecast33.0%
0%100%

Rationale

Management warned 'that memory costs could rise beyond the December quarter, while supply constraints may affect Mac and iPad into next year', and September's 47.9% carried about a point of tariff refunds that will not repeat. Against that, the March quarter leans more to Services, Apple raised iPhone prices by about $100, and it has 'longer-term memory contracts'. A further step below 45% is somewhat less likely than holding the 45%-46% range: one chance in three.
